name: JACOB
canonical: Jacob, called Israel, an aged Hebrew patriarch with weathered deeply-lined olive skin, a long flowing white beard and white hair, tender grieving deep-set eyes, wrapped in a layered patriarchal mantle of bold muted earthen stripes over a long robe, leaning heavily on a worn wooden staff and favouring his lamed thigh
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
